## autumn

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game art for a melancholy post-Soviet 2D runner. Match attached ART_DIRECTION.png painterly ink/gouache and muted collage texture. Cold desaturated slate blue gray palette, illustrated not photorealistic, no pixel art, no clean vector geometry, no orange light, no UI or captions. Transparent MIDGROUND parallax layer, 3:1 landscape. Side elevation of an autumn Soviet residential courtyard. Peeling plaster five-story apartment facades at the far left and right, low weathered yard walls, old rusty swing set and bench near center, leafless birch trees and sparse faded gray brown leaves, sagging overhead wires, drainpipes and exposed masonry. Vary architecture and silhouettes organically, detailed handpainted cracks and rain stains. Structures bottom 65%, thin trees extend upwards, LARGE truly transparent sky gaps between buildings/above courtyard, no painted sky. All environment grows up from perfectly horizontal base at bottom edge. No street surface, people, cats, collectible objects or foreground obstacles. Center courtyard open to a separate distant city layer. Modest worn house number plaque '92' near door, no other text. Seamless horizontal repeat with matched edge buildings/base, no heavy full-height black trunks. Actual alpha transparency, no checkerboard.
